verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents first-party escalation policies that route alert notifications to on-call schedules or individuals, so the core escalation capability exists. The evidence never describes the multi-step mechanics the story requires: per-step delays, fallback responders, or repeat rounds until acknowledgement. Missing for 10: documented multi-step escalation with time delays, fallback/next-tier responders, repeat rounds until acknowledgement, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, escalation policies walk unacknowledged pages through multiple steps — delays, fallback responders, and repeat rounds — until someone acknowledges

citations.quote: Escalation policies define how notifications from an Alert are sent to various team members, either as part of an on-call schedule or as an individual.
Signals offers a complete alerting solution with on-call schedules, escalation policies, and multi-platform notifications
This can be used as a target of an escalation policy
